name: Arquitectura E2E - Integración Técnica de Sistemas y Mensajería EDI
code:
flowchart TD
    subgraph ClientSystems ["💻 Sistemas del Cliente / Exportador"]
        ERP["🏢 ERP Corporativo (SAP S/4HANA / Oracle / Navision)"]
        EDI_Client["📡 Servidor EDI Cliente (EDIFACT ORDERS / DESADV)"]
        Portal_Web["🌐 Portal de Pedidos y Cotizaciones Web"]
    end

    subgraph AtlasSuite ["🚀 Atlas Logistics Cloud Suite & Middleware (Atlas Logistics)"]
        Atlas["🆔 TMS Atlas (Sistema Central de Gestión de Expedientes)"]
        API_GW["⚡ Atlas Logistics API Gateway & Message Broker"]
        CtrlTower["📊 Atlas Logistics Control Tower & Logistics Dashboard (Port 3000)"]
        ReconEngine["⚙️ Motor de Reconciliación Dual & Triangulación (15 min)"]
        Vault["🔒 SQLite Database & Bóveda AES-256-GCM"]
    end

    subgraph PCS_Platforms ["🏛️ Port Community Systems (PCS)"]
        Portic["⚓ Portic (Puerto de Barcelona - BCN)"]
        Valenciaport["⚓ Valenciaport PCS (Puerto de Valencia)"]
        BilbaoPCS["⚓ Teleport (Puerto de Bilbao)"]
    end

    subgraph OceanAirCarriers ["🚢 Navieras & Aerolíneas (Global Carriers)"]
        INTTRA["🌐 Plataforma INTTRA / TradeLens (e-Booking & VGM EDI)"]
        CarrierAPIs["📡 APIs Directas de Navieras (Maersk / MSC / CMA CGM / Hapag)"]
        AirCargo["✈️ IATA Cargo-XML & SITA Networks"]
    end

    subgraph CustomsAuthorities ["🛃 Autoridades Aduaneras & Reguladoras"]
        AEAT_VUA["🏛️ Ventanilla Única Aduanera (AEAT / EDIFACT CUSDEC)"]
        BCE["🏦 Banco Central Europeo (Feed Oficial FX Rates)"]
    end

    %% Flujos de integración técnica
    ERP -->|EDIFACT ORDERS / XML| API_GW
    Portal_Web -->|HTTPS REST| API_GW
    API_GW --> Atlas

    Atlas -->|Sincronización Bidireccional| CtrlTower
    CtrlTower -->|Consultas SQL WAL| Vault
    ReconEngine -->|Triangulación Horaria / MAPI| Vault

    Atlas -->|EDI 300 Booking Request| INTTRA
    Atlas -->|REST APIs JSON| CarrierAPIs
    INTTRA -->|EDI 301 Booking Confirmation| Atlas
    CarrierAPIs -->|Webhooks Status Updates| API_GW

    Atlas -->|EDI 304 Shipping Instructions| INTTRA
    Atlas -->|VERMAS EDIFACT| INTTRA
    INTTRA -->|VGM Aceptado| Portic
    INTTRA -->|VGM Aceptado| Valenciaport

    Atlas -->|EDIFACT DUA Export/Import| AEAT_VUA
    AEAT_VUA -->|Respuesta Circuito & Levante| Atlas
    AEAT_VUA -->|Levante Telemático| Portic
    AEAT_VUA -->|Levante Telemático| Valenciaport

    Portic -->|Gate-In / Gate-Out Events| API_GW
    Valenciaport -->|Tracking Portuario| API_GW
    BCE -->|JSON FX Rates| CtrlTower

    classDef client fill:#EFF6FF,stroke:#3B82F6,stroke-width:2px,color:#1E3A8A;
    classDef Atlas fill:#FEF2F2,stroke:#DC2626,stroke-width:2px,color:#991B1B;
    classDef pcs fill:#FFFBEB,stroke:#F59E0B,stroke-width:2px,color:#92400E;
    classDef carrier fill:#ECFEFF,stroke:#06B6D4,stroke-width:2px,color:#155E75;
    classDef customs fill:#FAF5FF,stroke:#8B5CF6,stroke-width:2px,color:#5B21B6;

    class ERP,EDI_Client,Portal_Web client;
    class Atlas,API_GW,CtrlTower,ReconEngine,Vault Atlas;
    class Portic,Valenciaport,BilbaoPCS pcs;
    class INTTRA,CarrierAPIs,AirCargo carrier;
    class AEAT_VUA,BCE customs;
